definitions: Keep safe or rescue (someone or something) from harm or danger.
Retain and store (something, especially data or a file).
Avoid spending or using (money, time, or a resource).
examples: They saved the child from drowning.
Remember to save your work frequently.
I'm trying to save money for a new car.
The bell saved him from answering the difficult question.
She saved a piece of cake for me.
